annotation.title_clean: Robustness and Explainability of Artificial Intelligence - From technical to policy solutions
annotation.title_en: Robustness and Explainability of Artificial Intelligence - From technical to policy solutions
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Hamon, R.; Junklewitz, H.; Sanchez, I.
annotation.venue: Publications Office of the European Union (JRC Technical Report EUR 30040)
annotation.summary_en: JRC technical report reviewing the robustness and explainability of AI, including adversarial vulnerabilities, transparency methods and data protection under GDPR. It recommends standardisation, certification and impact assessment tools for AI systems to support EU policymaking. It is not specific to robots or physical AI.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI systems introduce new attack vectors (data poisoning, adversarial examples) that threaten robustness.
GDPR rights relate to explainability of automated decisions, but opaque AI makes asserting them hard.
Post-hoc interpretability and interpretable models are presented as technical solutions to opacity.
Recommends standardisation and certification of AI robustness and impact assessments.
Gap remains between research outcomes and societal expectations, calling for regulatory response.
